title: Triviality on two slices and one fibre is open in a product family
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphisms of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] such that, for every morphism $T\to S$, with base changes $f_T:X_T=X\times_ST\to T$ and $g_T:Y_T=Y\times_ST\to T$ [def-pc-base-change], the canonical maps $\mathcal O_T\to(f_T)_*\mathcal O_{X_T}$ and $\mathcal O_T\to(g_T)_*\mathcal O_{Y_T}$ are isomorphisms. Let $\sigma:S\to X$ and $\tau:S\to Y$ be sections [def-pc-section] of $f$ and $g$, let $s\in S$, and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] on $X\times_SY$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If the pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] $(1\times\tau)^*\mathcal L$ along $1\times\tau:X=X\times_SS\to X\times_SY$ and $(\sigma\times1)^*\mathcal L$ along $\sigma\times1:Y=S\times_SY\to X\times_SY$ are trivial, and the restriction of $\mathcal L$ to the fibre $(X\times_SY)_s=(X\times_SY)\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is trivial, then there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$ such that $\mathcal L$ is trivial on $(X\times_SY)_U$.
